correctness.rationale: Gamma raw moment rising-factorial identity yields M2 and M4 exactly. Differentiation gives K prime equal to a strictly negative positive-denominator factor times Q. The quartic discriminant equals -6912(kappa+2)^2(2kappa+5)^2 times a manifestly positive square-plus-positive polynomial, hence exactly two simple real critical roots; signs at 0 and infinities put one on each half-line. The a=0 projective direction has nonzero derivative. Consequently the real projective line has one strict global minimum and maximum with exact equality classes, verified by symbolic identities and direct-density quadrature. Moment convergence gives the Gaussian large-shape endpoint limit.
